mapper.insert: insert into orders (number, status, user_id, address_book_id, order_time, checkout_time, pay_method, pay_status, amount, remark, phone, address, user_name, consignee, cancel_reason, rejection_reason, cancel_time, estimated_delivery_time, delivery_status, delivery_time, pack_amount, tableware_number, tableware_status) values (#{number}, #{status}, #{userId}, #{addressBookId}, #{orderTime}, #{checkoutTime}, #{payMethod}, #{payStatus}, #{amount}, #{remark}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{userName}, #{consignee}, #{cancelReason}, #{rejectionReason}, #{cancelTime}, #{estimatedDeliveryTime}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{deliveryTime}, #{packAmount}, #{tablewareNumber}, #{tablewareStatus})
mapper.update:
update orders
cancel_reason = #{cancelReason},
rejection_reason = #{rejectionReason},
cancel_time = #{cancelTime},
pay_status = #{payStatus},
pay_method = #{payMethod},
checkout_time = #{checkoutTime},
status = #{status},
delivery_time = #{deliveryTime}
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, sum(amount) as turnover from orders where status = #{status} and order_time >= #{begin} and order_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date

select date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(*) as totalOrderCount, sum(IF(status = 5, 1, 0)) as validOrderCount from orders where order_time >= #{begin} and order_time < #{end} group by date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (SELECT DATE(#{begin}) AS date UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_range WHERE date < DATE(#{end}) - INTERVAL 1 DAY) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(dr.date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, IFNULL(SUM(IF(o.status = 5, o.amount, 0)), 0) AS turnover, IFNULL(SUM(IF(o.status = 5, 1, 0)), 0) AS validOrderCount, COUNT(o.id) AS totalOrderCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(o.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(SUM(IF(o.status = 5, 1, 0)), 0) / COUNT(o.id) END AS orderCompletionRate, CASE WHEN IFNULL(SUM(IF(o.status = 5, 1, 0)), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE IFNULL(SUM(IF(o.status = 5, o.amount, 0)), 0) / SUM(IF(o.status = 5, 1, 0)) END AS unitPrice, IFNULL(MAX(uc.newUserCount), 0) AS newUsers FROM date_range dr LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_time >= dr.date AND o.order_time < DATE_ADD(dr.date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS newUserCount FROM user WHERE create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY DATE(create_time)) uc ON uc.date = dr.date GROUP BY dr.date ORDER BY dr.date;
